svg.title: The Agent Mesh: Agent pods on the NATS bus
svg.desc: Five example Agents, Trading Assistant (read-only: it informs the Operator), Research Assistant, Risk Monitor, Book-Keeper and Software Engineer, each run by its own agent runtime in its own pod, joined to one NATS JetStream bus inside a Kubernetes cluster. The agent runtime checks each message, applies the Gate, keeps the Agent to its budget and writes the record. The control plane joins the same bus; the Operator calls the control API from outside, through the command line. Plain lines join the bus; arrows show who calls whom.
